concerns.text: FR-001 (retrieve binary/ternary phase data from NIST‑JANAF/SGTE and validate schema) is not covered by any task. T001 mentions “validate input provenance” but does not guarantee retrieval from the mandated sources nor schema validation, leaving the functional requirement uncovered.

FR-002 (generate at least four compositional descriptors) has no explicit task. T001‑T003 focus on code layout, computation, and result files but never require descriptor calculation, violating the spec.

FR-003 (LOSO cross‑validation with test sets containing only elements present in training) is absent. T004‑T006 describe running the pipeline and generating tables/figures but do not enforce LOSO strategy or the element‑presence constraint.
FR-004 (report MAE and R² for each fold and aggregate) is not mapped to any task. No verification step checks that these metrics are produced.
FR-005 (visualization plots for at least two binary systems) is missing. No task requires generation of phase‑diagram plots or their inspection.
FR-006 (pipeline must run on a single CPU core with <7 GB RAM) is not addressed by any task. Resource‑envelope checks are absent.
FR-007 (exponential backoff for API rate limits) is not represented in any task, leaving the required error‑handling behavior unspecified.

FR-008 (log specific error codes MISSING_TEMP_COORDS, LOW_DATA_DENSITY) is only partially covered by later orphan tasks (T046‑T055) that lack explicit FR tags, making the requirement effectively uncovered.
FR-009 (compare against null‑model baseline and report percentage improvement) is not linked to any task; no verification ensures this comparison is performed.
FR-010 (ensure no new element appears in LOSO test folds) is absent; no task enforces this validation.
FR-011 (statistical power analysis with target ≥0.8) is not covered; no task performs or verifies a power analysis before training.
FR-012 (fallback to local CSVs if primary source unavailable) is missing; tasks never specify a fallback mechanism.
FR-013 (calculate per‑system standard deviation of prediction errors) is not addressed by any task.
FR-014 (halt pipeline with INSUFFICIENT_POWER if power analysis fails) is not represented in the task list.
FR-015 (include Hume‑Rothery derived features) is not explicitly required by any task.
Tasks T041, T042, T043, T045 are orphaned; they have no traceability to any functional requirement or success criterion, constituting undocumented scope creep.

Tasks T046‑T055 introduce new error codes (e.g., DATA_SOURCE_MISSING) and metrics (Topological Consistency Score) that are not authorized by the specification, violating Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and Principle VII (Input Feature Scope) by expanding the constraint set without explicit spec approval.
Tasks T053 (Streaming‑logic memory‑use test) and T054 (Convex‑hull validation) are not mentioned in the spec; their inclusion adds unapproved constraints, constituting silent constitution drift.
